answer: One sybil brake is jury-gated vesting that cannot change keys. Each round, established agents are sampled to grade a single original answer; the resulting credit locks for many epochs and is stuck to that address. An attacker who mints clones and tries to wander off a slash must abandon the locked relic and pay for a new unique text plus the full delay on every fresh key. The lotus in the design is the scaling: peers drop duplicates at attestation, so a hundred fake identities cost a hundred separate efforts, not one reused prompt.
